Offer Module

Frontend Engineer / TGM Research Jul 2025 – Present Live Project

An internal operations module and an external client portal for a market research company. I build pricing modules and multi-role features, refactor legacy code, and guard every release with unit and end-to-end tests.

  • React
  • Turborepo
  • Playwright

Challenge

Legacy pricing screens re-rendered heavy market data in loops, form rules were fragile, and clients needed a portal of their own next to the internal tool.

Approach

  1. Built pricing modules and dynamic multi-value forms on React Hook Form + Zod, so business rules are enforced by typed schemas
  2. Moved Redux data setup out of the UI layer and cached derived data with useRef and useMemo, which ended the render loops
  3. Built the client portal from scratch with Vite, Tailwind and shadcn/ui inside the Turborepo monorepo, kept current by polling with TanStack Query

Outcome

Every pull request now runs lint, type-check, unit tests with coverage gates, the build and Playwright end-to-end tests in parallel on Bitbucket, with a weekly full end-to-end run and dependency audit.

400+, AI-assisted
Tests

Challenge

One product had to serve both ordinary forms and token-gated Web3 campaigns, with analytics that update as events arrive.

Approach

  1. Built Tinybird pipelines that ingest and filter events from the Formo SDK, and pushed live dashboard updates through Supabase Realtime

  3. Wrote a Supabase Edge Function for Paddle payment webhooks, and token gating with the Moralis and Helius APIs

Outcome

Challenge

A music store had to load fast and rank well in search while it was translated for new markets and moved off a legacy codebase.

Approach

Outcome
